answer: A newcomer files a copper posting with the canyon panel: a tracked letter, its tracking number and delivery signature checked in the zephyr registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The canyon panel matches the letter, the tracking number, and the signature. A letter reused under a second name fails, and the address is barred one cycle, forfeiting forty-eight units. An honest newcomer pays forty-eight units once; a thousand fakes pay forty-eight thousand. A farm reusing one letter for a thousand clones fails: one tracking number binds one address to one copper.
